insurer_name: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Bundled product: my:health Suraksha indemnity + Critical Suraksha Plus + Medisure Super Top Up + Hospital Cash + Koti Suraksha PA + Travel + Bharat Griha Raksha + E@Secure. Waiting Period modification option available.

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Room, boarding, ICU, consultation, anaesthesia, blood, oxygen, OT, surgical appliances, drugs, diagnostics, implants.

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Home Healthcare option for Medically Necessary Treatment with pre/post hospitalisation cover.

ayush_coverage.notes: Ayurveda / Unani / Siddha / Homeopathy / Yoga & Naturopathy in AYUSH Hospital.

maternity_coverage.notes: Optional Parent and Child Care Cover - Basic / Booster; up to 2 deliveries or 1 delivery + 1 termination; infertility treatment up to 50% of normal delivery SI under Booster.

newborn_coverage.notes: New Born Baby Cover including vaccinations under Booster option.

ambulance_cover.notes: Road ambulance to nearest hospital / between hospitals / hospital-to-home in same city. Air Ambulance optional cover.

critical_illness_cover.notes: Section 2 my:health Critical Suraksha Plus included.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Sum Insured Rebound — adds claim-paid amount back up to Basic SI.
restoration_benefit.notes: Optional; applicable annually for multi-year policies.

preventive_health_checkup.notes: After every block of 4 claim-free years; Preventive Health Check-Up Booster option for annual checkup; HDFC ERGO Mobile App fitness discount up to 10%.

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: International cover available via add-ons (Travel Insurance section).

permanent_exclusions: Treatment outside India (unless international cover opted)
notable_exclusions_summary: Sampoorna Suraksha is a bundle proposition combining indemnity + critical illness + super top-up + hospital cash + PA + travel + property + cyber. Mental healthcare covered per Mental Healthcare Act 2017.
available_riders: Parent & Child Care Cover - Basic / Booster
